profile.headline: Software Developer at IBM
profile.summary:
Hi, I'm Tiffany! I'm an alumna who studied Computer Engineering at San Jose State University.

I currently work at IBM as part of the Db2 AI for z/OS team. I previously worked at a data streaming app startup for 2 years, and also interned at Cisco and Amazon Web Services during my undergraduate years.

Feel free to connect!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Developed library in Java and Kotlin to periodically upload data of customers’ usage and hardware metrics to Amazon S3
• Devised library design fulfilling project requirements and collaborated with peers to optimize the design
• Created comprehensive test suite for the Java/Kotlin library using JUnit that covered all test cases
• Integrated application with MySQL database applier and deployed test environment; successfully uploaded all database replicas from test environment to S3
• Implemented Bash script that generates a report on data from S3 along with a URL to build a dashboard for user metrics

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a Python-based application that fulfills feature requirements and migrates all existing defects and features from original tracking tool into a new instance
• Improved team workflow and efficiency by centralizing product defects and features into a single place  
• Utilized various key technologies including Linux, Docker, Python, and REST API as required
• Presented application to teammates and business stakeholders in multi-site conference; received positive feedback
• Worked remotely during the pandemic, demonstrating ability to learn and contribute independently and effectively

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Collaborated with fellow SWE++ chairs to create a 10-week program to teach female middle schoolers Python
• Created and sent a feedback form for students to anonymously fill out at the end of each session to improve future sessions and address concerns students had
• Posted clarifying answers to students’ concerns in the class Discord and held office hours weekly

• Represented SWE in events that empower minorities in engineering and encourage young girls to be interested in engineering, such as ALAS Conference and WOW! That’s Engineering Conference 
• Managed on-campus events, like Admitted Spartan Day, to recruit new students and increase overall club membership 
• Collaborated with sister SWE chapters to organize the annual Empowered Women Empower Women panel; in May 2019 had a successful turnout of 60 women from various universities in the Bay Area
• Planned transportation for members to attend off-campus events and actively advertises events to grow participation
• Organized fun science projects for female high school students in SWENext Club to further their interests in STEM

projects.title: Blips
projects.description:
Worked in a team of six to build a full stack Casino web application (contains games: Blackjack, Coin Flip, and Slots) for users to play on

• Implemented database script using MySQL for full stack application where data could be queried
• Designed front-end page for one of the features in the application (Javascript and HTML/CSS)

projects.title: IR Beacon
projects.description:
ENGR 10 Final Project:
- Design a robot that will turn off green beacon and get red beacon out of the arena
- Environment to integrate software into hardware was EasyC
- Group had the most optimal design and fastest performance time

My role was to code the program that will control the robot to do assigned tasks and assist programming partner to get familiar with C.
